title: AION market calendar data manifest
description: Identical for every package. This is what makes one ingestion tool able to maintain all of them: the manifest is the contract, the payload beneath it is not.

schema_version.description: Bumped only for a breaking change to this manifest format. A client that does not recognise the value must refuse the data rather than guess.

dataset_version.description: ISO-like and monotonic, e.g. 2026.09.12. Compared as a string, so the format must sort correctly; a semver-style value would not.

last_updated.description: UTC, ISO 8601. A client fetches only if the remote value is greater than its own.

next_review_date.description: When a human should refresh the upcoming year. Exchanges publish next year's calendar in the autumn, so this lands before then. A reminder, not an expiry.

years.description: Years for which payload files exist. A date outside these has no data, and the client must answer 'not a holiday' rather than invent one.

files.description: Filename to SHA-256 of its bytes. EVERY file must verify before ANY is adopted. This is the guard whose absence caused the 2026-06-26 incident, when a 105-byte delta overwrote a 117 KB taxonomy.
